description: China's overseas labour dispatch (对外劳务合作) — monthly YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE count (in 10,000-person units) of Chinese workers dispatched abroad, split by whether they went out under contracted-engineering projects or under standalone labour-cooperation contracts, plus the year-over-year change (an ABSOLUTE change in 10,000-person units, not a percent). Sourced live from MOFCOM's (商务部) data centre, keyless. Values reset down every January. Answers "how many Chinese workers are sent abroad", "China overseas labour export trend".

end_period.description: Latest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recent available month.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first (default 24, max 500). Ignored range still comes from start_period/end_period — this only caps how many of those rows come back.

start_period.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM (e.g. "2024-01" or "202401"). Omit for full history.

name: mofcom_labor_cooperation
